s: Din lebishat begadim ubo t' seipim: umippene shemmechuyyab haadam lihyot tamid emat boreo alayv — yihyeh tzanua bekol maasayv, shehatztzeniut vehabboshet mebiin lide haknaa lipne hashshem yitbarek. Lepikak, mi sheyyashen arom belo chaluq — kesheyyaqum tob lizzaher shello yesheb veachar-kak yilbash chaluqo, shemmiyyad kesheyyesheb hu megulleh, ella yiqqach chaluqo veyaknis bo rosho uzerootayv beodennu shokeb, venimtza kesheyyaqum hu kebar mekusseh. Veal yomar: hineni bechadre chadarim mi roeni, ki haqqadosh-baruk-hu melo kol haolam kebodo, asher lepanayv "kachasheka kaora":

Vetob lekol adam ledaqdeq bachaluqo lelobsho kedarko, shello yahapok happenimi lachutz, veyerau hattepirot hamgunnot, veyitganneh beene habberiyyot. Veim lo nizhar vehapak happenimi lachutz, im hu talmid chakam — tzarik leposhto velachazor lelobsho kedarko, shello yihyeh biklal "kol mesanay ahabu mavet", sheyyomru habberiyyot: kamma megunnim lomede tora:

Tob lizzaher millilbosh shene malbushim yachad bebat achat, mippene sheqqasheh leshikcha. Vetob sheyyasim shene tzidde hammalbush beyad yemino veyilbash hayyamin veachar-kak hassemol, ulekavven: ki hakkol niklal bayyamin umin hayyamin ba lassemol:

Lepi shemmatzinu shehayyamin hi chashuba bekol hattora kullah: leinyan bohen yad ubohen regel shel milluim veshel metzora, veken leinyan chalitza — laken gam binilat minalim tzarik litten chashibut layyamin, velinol shel yamin techilla. Ulepi shemmatzinu shebbiqshirat tepillin chashuba yad semol, shealeha qosherin et hattepillin, laken gam kan biqshirat minalim — tzarik litten chashibut lehassemol, velaken lo yiqshor et hamminal shel yamin ad sheyyinol shel semol veyiqsherennu, veachar-kak yiqshor shel yamin. Ubeminalim shellanu sheen bahem qeshira — yinol shel yamin techilla, mippene sheen notenim chashibut lehassemol ella gabbe qeshira bilbad, dumeya diqshirat tepillin:
Keshecholetz minalayv — choletz shel semol techilla, mippene shezzehu kebodah shel yamin:
Keshehu rochetz o sak — yirchotz o yasuk shel yamin techilla. Ukeshehu rochetz o sak kol gupo — yirchotz o yasuk rosho techilla, mippene shehu melek al kol haebarim:

Veyaqum veyelek bikpipat qoma, mippene sheasur lelek beqoma zequpa, apillu pachot mearba ammot, shenneemar: "melo kol haaretz kebodo", mashma shemmishtarbeb hakkabod veyored lematta, vehazzoqep qomato — nireh kedocheq. Velo yelek arba ammot begilluy harosh. Umiddat chasidut shello yelek apillu pachot mearba ammot, veshello lesheb kelal begilluy harosh. Vaapillu qetannim — nakon lekassot rosham, ki heki deteheve alayhu emata dishmayya:

Veachar-kak yibdoq neqabayv, shemma yitztarek linqabayv beemtza hattepilla. Ameru chakamim: kol harotzeh leqabbel alayv ol malkut shamayim shelema — yippaneh veyittol yadayv, veachar-kak yiqra qeriat shema veyitpallel. Uleolam yargil adam et atzmo lippanot boqer vaereb, beshaa sheen bene adam metzuyin bashshuq, kede shello yitztarek leharchiq. Vaapillu bemaqom sheeno tzarik leharchiq, kegon sheyyesh lo bet hakkisse bebeto — ap-al-pi-ken yargil et atzmo lippanot boqer vaereb, mippene shehu zerizut uneqiyyut, umebi lide qedushsha:

Ameru chakamim: "ubeshiplut yadayim yidlop habbayit", al yede sheadam mitatztzel lekassot gupo karauy — "yidlop habbayit", yaaleh gupo chatatim, mikkan lamadnu sheyyesh laadam lekassot kol gupo. Veal yelek yachep. Veod ameru chakamim: hammonea minalim meraglayv — hare hu kimnuddeh lammaqom. Uleolam yimkor adam kol mah sheyyesh lo, veyiqqach minalim leraglayv:
